column1: # apps.tsv — Material file icons reused as application icons
# Third-party applications are not redrawn by hand: a desktop entry whose icon
# already exists in the vendored Material set under the same name (VS Code, whose
# .desktop uses Icon=vscode and whose file icon is the same logo) is published
# under its application name here. Everything else stays unmapped on purpose and
# resolves through Inherits (hicolor) to the vendor artwork the package installs,
# which is better than a hand-approximated brand logo -- and better than the
# Mint-Y restyled square that would otherwise win the fallback chain.
